proofs.text: On the 0.10 fixture find the spec holding `msvcrt.locking`, verify it carries the retired scope tag, apply, and verify it reads `@env(windows)` with the retired tag gone; decline the rewrite and verify both the retired tag and `@env(` are gone and the output says it would rather not guess. On the v0.9.5 fixture verify the same spec's retired tier tag becomes one `PROOF-53` line ending `@unit @env(windows)`. Verify a scope naming no operating system is dropped with that reason printed, and that a placeholder in prose is still there after the run

reasons: PROOF-13 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: A proof's retired operating-system tag becomes `@env(<os>)` when the person confirms the system it names, is dropped when they decline or when it names no operating system, and the retired tier tag becomes `@unit @env(windows)`; text that only looks like a tag is left alone

tests.body:
def test_a_confirmed_scope_becomes_env(tmp_path):
    root = _project(tmp_path, V010)
    rel = _spec_holding(root, 'msvcrt.locking')
    assert SCOPE in _read(root, rel)
    _apply(root)
    text = _read(root, rel)
    assert '@env(windows)' in text
    assert SCOPE not in text
tests.name: test_a_confirmed_scope_becomes_env
